variants.headline: Looking back: a company goes under
variants.sub: The colony has seen the failure of {company}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The company {company} had gone under.

Workers are not an incidental detail in the politics of business failure. Labour should keep ordinary lives in view without inventing a dismissal or an unpaid wage. Solidarity requires attention to people, and a careful account should not claim to know their particular circumstances merely because a company has gone under.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We take a sympathetic view of {target}. A failed enterprise does not establish every accusation of poor conduct, and fair assessment must survive an outcome that makes easy blame particularly tempting.

variants.headline: Looking back: business failure enters the colony's record
variants.body:

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

variants.headline: Looking back: an enterprise reaches failure
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The business {company} had gone under.

Workers are not an incidental detail in the politics of business failure. Labour should keep ordinary lives in view without inventing a dismissal or an unpaid wage. Solidarity requires attention to people, and a careful account should not claim to know their particular circumstances merely because a company has gone under.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

We take a sympathetic view of {target}. A failed enterprise does not establish every accusation of poor conduct, and fair assessment must survive an outcome that makes easy blame particularly tempting.
